notes:
Lead origin: self-serve signup from G2 ad; converted to contact after spike in usage flagged by billing (2026-02-09).

Discovery summary:
- SMB SaaS (customer support automation). 70 employees, ~30 engineers.
- Primary interest: Hosted API (self-serve) to power chat agent + doc search in their web product.
- Traffic profile: steady baseline (50 req/min) with marketing-triggered bursts up to 400 req/min for short windows (30s-2m). Seen repeated 429s during Black Friday-style campaigns and weekly newsletter sends.
- Token profile: typical message roundtrip ~350 tokens, embeddings batch jobs off-peak.

Rate-limiting / quotas specifics (customer):
- Wants per-team and per-api-key quotas; ability to set soft limits for dev vs prod teams.
- Concerned about 429 handling: wants clear Retry-After header and guidance on exponential backoff + jitter.
- Needs guarantee that short burst traffic (10s-120s) can be absorbed w/o large-scale failures; open to a small paid "burst buffer" add-on for hosted_api.
- Concurrency target: want ~20-40 concurrent generation requests sustained; spikes to 150-200 concurrent for <2 minutes are main painpoint.
- Backpressure expectations: prefer graceful 503/queued responses over opaque 429s when possible, plus webhook for dropped requests so they can reconcile.

Security/compliance notes:
- SMB but security-conscious: SSO (SAML) required for admin portal, audit logging of API key use requested, retention controls optional.
- No need for private/VPC yet — public cloud ok.

- 2026-02-10: lead created (self-serve sign-up, billing alert).

Customer quotes / paraphrases from call:
- "We see huge micro-bursts after marketing sends — the app becomes noisy with 429s and users report timeouts."
- "We want to avoid building complex retry glue if the platform can give us predictable behavior and a burst window."

Value metrics they care about:
- Reduction in user-visible errors during spikes (measure by % 429s per campaign).
- Cost per active conversation (target <$0.02 per conv-turn).
- Predictable billing for burst capacity versus unexpected overage charges.

- Confirm if Redwood provides short-term burst credit (how many concurrent rps/min for how long) and pricing tiers.
